info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Funds Confirmation API
info.description: The Funds Confirmation API provides a secure mechanism for validating the availability of funds for international scheduled payments. By invoking this endpoint, users can asynchronously check the current status of their funds consent, ensuring that sufficient resources are available before initiating a payment. This API is typically consumed by financial institutions and payment service providers, aiding them in their compliance with open banking standards while enhancing transaction reliability. It plays a crucial role in streamlining payment processes and improving customer experience in banking services.

get.summary: Retrieve funds confirmation for the specified international scheduled payment consent.
get.description: This operation allows you to check the confirmation of funds availability for a specific international scheduled payment consent identified by the consent ID. It ensures the funds are available before proceeding with the payment.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a funds confirmation for an international scheduled payment consent. It supports the retrieval of funds availability information crucial for proceeding with the payment transaction.

200.description: Funds are available and confirmation successful.
